datameshToken.title: Datamesh token
datameshToken.description: Your Oceanum Datamesh token or JWT. Obtain at https://home.oceanum.io/account.

datameshUiUrl.title: Datamesh UI URL
datameshUiUrl.description: Address of the Datamesh UI shown in the Datamesh panel. Use the address it is finally served from: the panel only accepts workspace updates from this address's origin, so an address that redirects to another origin will not update the workspace.

aiBackendUrl.title: Oceanum AI URL
aiBackendUrl.description: Address of the Oceanum AI backend used by the AI chat.

autoRunCode.title: Auto-run code
autoRunCode.description: Run code cells the AI inserts as soon as they are placed.

iterate.title: Iterate
iterate.description: After running, send each cell's output back to the AI so it can fix an error or take the next step. Only takes effect with Auto-run code on.
